B00JJY1QG0.title: Lutron Caseta Smart Lamp Dimmer Kit; Plug-In Dimmer & Pico Wireless Remote
bullets: ADD A SWITCH TO YOUR LAMPS: Avoid walking through a dark room to turn your lamps on or off. Simply plug the lamp into the lamp dimmer/switch and put the Pico remote at the entrance of the room. Perfect for bedrooms with nightstand lamps or living rooms that have lamps

WIRELESS CONTROL: Pico remote can mount flush against the wall or in a j-box using the included adapter and fits inside a standard wallplate. Can also put on a side table, coffee table or island for easy control of your lights
DIMMER OR SWITCH: Plug-in dimmer can be changed into "switch mode" with simple button press programming, if you are not looking to dim your lights.

SMART EXPANSION: Add a Lutron Caseta Hub to control with the app or through Alexa, Apple Home, Google Assistant, Ring, or other home assistants. With the Caseta Hub, you can set schedules or scenes through the app

PEACE OF MIND: Always come back to a well-lit home with the smart Lutron dimmer switch; enable Smart Away to randomly turn your lights on/off so it looks like you’re home even when away, using this dimmable light switch (Caseta Smart Hub required)
SMART CONTROL OF PLUG-IN LAMPS: This light dimmer switch plug in plugs into a standard outlet and can be used with up to two table or floor lamps
KIT INCLUDES: The kit includes (1) Lutron Caseta plug-in LED dimmer switch for lamps; coordinating accessories sold separately

WIRELESS REMOTE CONTROL LUTRON LIGHT SWITCH: The included Pico remote acts as a wireless light switch, giving you on/off and dimming control from anywhere in the room; a flexible option within this wireless light switch

GET MORE, SPEND LESS: This Lutron dimmer switch for lamps allows control of multiple plug-in lamp fixtures at once, making many fixtures smart, even your existing bulbs; get smart control of dimmable LED, incandescent, and halogen bulbs

KIT INCLUDES: The kit includes (1) Lutron Caseta plug-in LED dimmer switch for lamps; coordinating accessories sold separately
